name: brazil-cnpj-lookup
title: Brazil CNPJ Lookup & Monitor (Receita Federal company data)
description: Look up Brazilian companies by CNPJ in bulk: legal name, status, CNAE activities, address, phone, e-mail, Simples/MEI, share capital and partners (QSA). Validates CNPJs for free, uses multiple open-data sources and can flag what changed since your last run.
